description: Scan one offer/pitch for 12 evidence-quoted scam red flags plus live URL anchors (HTTP/TLS/DNS, RDAP domain age). Use when you must decide whether a specific offer or seller page is a scam before paying or replying. Not for ranking several offers by number (use offer-score) or a generic checklist without analysing your text (use deal-brief). Pick this when the question is 'is THIS offer a scam?'. Returns a free sample plus the paid URL and pay steps (no charge here); the full result costs $0.25 Base USDC via x402.
